cases.label: Known stable framework — returns version string and changed=false
cases.note: nist-800-53 is a stable entry; changed should be false unless a new OSCAL release has been detected

cases.label: Unknown framework_id — returns error, not fabricated version data
cases.note: Unknown framework_id must return error; never fabricate a version string or changed value

cases.label: Retired framework — returns changed=false and draft_status=retired
cases.note: FFIEC CAT was sunset Aug 2025; retired frameworks must return changed=false — they do not update
